headline: Favorable report from the budget committee on the supplementary budget
summary: The Senate budget committee approved a favorable report on a bill amending the 2026 General State Budget. It adds 54,100 million pesos in spending and raises the fiscal deficit to 4.2%. The bill had already passed the Chamber of Deputies.
why: Budget deficits and extra spending affect sovereign borrowing needs, bond yields and the outlook for the country's currency. Investors track these fiscal changes in emerging markets.
original_headline: Informe favorable de la comisión de presupuesto sobre el presupuesto complementario
